notes.text: רפ״ז is conventionally expanded as “beginning of chapter 7,” not “end”; no edition-specific locator has been independently checked. The supplied text has פכסס and chapter 7; earlier machine OCR had פכסם and chapter 6. Those machine readings are not accepted printed alternatives.
